BiblicalUsage: hierós is the word for holy. I meet it 68 times across the Bible, and Matthew is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hierós matters because holiness is not an extra to who God is — it is who He is. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
RelatedEvents: The Temptation in the Wilderness; The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple; The Cleansing of the Temple
